subject: MAP blueprint & sprint proposal for Lambda Health evaluation
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP blueprint & sprint proposal for Lambda Health evaluation

Team —

Attaching a first-pass MAP skeleton for Lambda Health. Goal: give the customer a tight 30–45 day evaluation with clear acceptance criteria so we can accelerate to a pilot contract. High-level items in the doc:
- Goals & success metrics (product + business KPIs)
- Key stakeholders & decision owners
- 30/60 day milestone plan with required artifacts/deliverables
- Risk & compliance checkpoints (SOC2 evidence, data flows)
- Uptake & adoption criteria to qualify for pilot pricing

Asks:
1) Marissa — please add a short demo agenda and suggested datasets for the initial workload.
2) Laura — include any compliance blockers we should flag up front.
3) Jonas — can you propose a minimal infra checklist for their on-prem option?

I uploaded a stubbed Google Doc (redwood-map-template-v1.gdoc) and a draft slide section in the doc itself. I also copied a simple close sprint proposal underneath the milestone table — this will become the ‘30-day try + pilot decision’ path.

Please provide inline edits/comments by EOD Friday (2026-11-06) so I can send the customer the draft next Monday.

Attachments: redwood-map-template-v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub)

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez

Thanks — quick edits in thread:

Sergio — I added a 20-minute show-and-tell to the demo agenda (Day 3) and suggested the two sample datasets we should bring:
- anonymized appointment logs (3 months)
- sample patient intake forms (structured + free text)

Also added a line under acceptance criteria: "Average 95th percentile latency < 350ms for inference on a 1k qps test or documented fallback plan."

Inline: see bullet "Deliverables -> Demo artifacts" where I listed the slide pack and a short evaluation script.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP blueprint & sprint proposal for Lambda Health evaluation

Adding compliance notes:
- We should include a pre-demo checklist for data minimization & PCA/PII review. Recommend adding the SOC2 artifacts list and an itemized evidence collection plan.
- If they want on-prem, we need a short note about audit logging (we can supply the runtime logs but they will likely request retention policies).
- I attached a one-pager we can point to (SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf) — will add to the GDoc.

Also flagged a potential blocker: their security contact typically requires a dedicated subnet and proof of key-management integration. If procurement is tight, call this out early so we can evaluate Dedicated capacity vs Hosted.

Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: David Jenkins <david.jenkins@lambdahealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lambdahealth.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 12:09:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP blueprint & sprint proposal for Lambda Health evaluation

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for sharing. This looks promising. A few notes from our side:

1) Evaluation KPIs: can you add a short table that maps objective -> metric -> target? We care specifically about: inference latency (p95), cost per 1k queries, and classification recall for our triage model.
2) Data: we can provide a 2-week slice of real production logs (anonymized) for the demo. Will that be enough?
3) Timeline: our internal approvals are week-of Nov 23; if we start the evaluation the week of Nov 30 we should be able to make a pilot decision mid-Jan. Can you reflect a slightly longer cadence so approvals don't compress the work?

Also — would be great to see a quick note on how Redwood handles KV cache warmup behavior for initial load (we saw cold-start variability in earlier vendors).

Thanks — I put Procurement on cc to start the contract thread when we align.

Regards,
David Jenkins
Director, Platform Engineering | Lambda Health
david.jenkins@lambdahealth.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP blueprint & sprint proposal for Lambda Health evaluation

David — thanks for the clear asks, that’s helpful. I updated the GDoc with a KPI mapping table (latency p95 / cost / recall) and a short note on cache warmup and mitigation (auto-prefetch + warmup run). Link below. I also lengthened the cadence so the MAP shows a Nov 30 start and a mid-Jan pilot decision window.

Next steps (action items):
- Internal: Marissa to finalize demo script and test dataset selection by Thu 11/12.
- Internal: Jonas to draft the minimal infra checklist for on-prem + hosted fallback by Fri 11/13.
- Internal: Laura to attach SOC2 evidence list and recommended retention policy by Mon 11/16.
- External: David / Procurement to confirm Nov 30 start and share required PO/contract timeline.

I added the Lambda-specific KPI sheet as an attachment (lambda-eval-kpis.xlsx) and pushed the editable MAP doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-map-blueprint-v1 (permission: comment).

I’m scheduling a 30-minute MAP kickoff for Tue Nov 30 10:00–10:30 PT — calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=map-kickoff-lambdahealth. Please accept if you can.

Sergio Alvarez
